relationships.subject: ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: ROS can specifically activate the NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: the activated NLRP3 inflammasome can release ROS by inducing an inflammatory response and recruiting neutrophils and macrophages

relationships.subject: ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: the ROS production induced by MSU crystals activates transient Receptor Potential Ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) in sensory neurons as well as transient receptor potential vanilloid-1 (TRPV1)

key_findings: Review: ROS form a central network linking NLRP3 inflammasome, MAPK, NETs, autophagy, ferroptosis and Nrf2 in gouty arthritis.
Targeting the ROS network is proposed as a therapeutic strategy for gout and tophus prevention.
